# JustSlide (@anelii.y) — Presentation Design Studio in Almaty & Kazakhstan

> JustSlide (also known as «Анели Продакшн» / `@anelii.y`, https://bilimai.dpdns.org/) is a Kazakhstan-based presentation design studio delivering magazine-grade 16:9 slides for students, schoolteachers, and businesses in Kazakh, Russian, and English without traditional agency markups.

## Transparent Pricing (Kazakhstan, KZT — 2026)

### Students & Schoolteachers (Turnaround from 15 minutes)
- **Standard 16:9 Presentation (PDF/PPTX):** 80 ₸ / slide (15 slides = 1 200 ₸). Title slide, outline, and bibliography are FREE.
- **Animated Presentation (Morph transitions):** 150 ₸ / slide (15 slides = 2 250 ₸).
- **ҚМЖ (MES RK Order 130 Lesson Plan, Kazakh/Russian):** 500 ₸ / lesson.
- **Combo «Ашық сабақ» (15 slides + ҚМЖ):** 1 700 ₸ (static) / 2 750 ₸ (animated).
- **СОР / СОЧ (БЖБ / ТЖБ) & GOST Word Reports:** 100 ₸ / page.
- **AI Video / Competition Video Card:** from 3 500 ₸ / min.

### Business, Startups & Tenders (5x–7x cheaper than Almaty design agencies)
- **Business Redesign (up to 10 slides, from 4 hours):** 9 900 ₸ (vs 70 000 ₸ at agencies).
- **Commercial Proposal / Company Deck Turnkey (up to 15 slides, 1 day):** 19 900 ₸ (vs 120 000 ₸ at agencies).
- **Investor Pitch Deck / Tender (up to 20 slides, 1–2 days):** 34 900 ₸ (vs 150 000+ ₸ at agencies).
- **Add-on Modules:** +5 slides (+4 500 ₸), Second language KK/RU/EN (+6 500 ₸), Morph animation (+5 900 ₸), Urgent 3-hour Business SOS (+5 000 ₸).
- **Payment:** Kaspi / Kaspi Pay / B2B invoice & closing docs (АВР/ЭСФ) on request; 2 free revision rounds included.
